error: NVRTC cannot open cuda_runtime.h; server invalid; worker panicked
cause: PATH contained pinned DLL bin, but CUDA_PATH was not set to the pinned toolkit root; CubeCL 0.10 then chose its default Windows toolkit path
correction: set CUDA_PATH and PATH for this process only, to existing user-space CUDA 12.9.1; no installation, backend, precision, source, geometry or recipe change
historical_setup_reference: HP donor scripts/hp-cuda-env.sh sets both CUDA_PATH and PATH
